title: Joytun Chemicals — Corporate Website
desc: A home and personal care website that connects everyday lifestyle imagery with a structured product collection. The interface gives the Joytun range a calm, approachable digital presence.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Warm ivory surfaces, olive accents and generous spacing support a welcoming brand experience. A large lifestyle hero introduces the company before visitors explore care categories and individual products.

caseStudy.title: Website experience
caseStudy.text: The experience connects laundry, hand, kitchen, floor, glass and bathroom care through category navigation. Product pages, company information and distribution enquiries give the collection a clear route from discovery to contact.

gallery.caption: Live homepage of Joytun Chemical Industries OPC — website design and development by MD. AL-AMIN ALI.

title: Orbit Lubricants — Product Website
desc: An automotive and heavy-duty lubricant website built around product discovery, application groups and clear specification information.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Dark navy, industrial photography and orange highlights establish the Orbit identity. Prominent typography and a structured catalogue connect brand presentation with practical product information.

caseStudy.title: Website experience
caseStudy.text: The homepage groups products by motorcycle, passenger car, CNG, heavy-duty diesel, transmission and monograde applications. Product specifications, a lubricant finder and sales enquiry routes support visitors looking for the appropriate range.

gallery.caption: Live homepage of Orbit Lubricant Industries — website design and development by MD. AL-AMIN ALI.

title: CreatifyBD — Creative Agency Website
desc: A creative agency website bringing services, work samples, packages and project enquiries into one connected digital experience.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: A white canvas, red accents and strong typography frame the agency services. Creative imagery and work galleries give visitors a visual introduction before they explore individual offerings.

caseStudy.title: Website experience
caseStudy.text: Service pages cover graphic design, video, social media and website work. The portfolio, pricing and contact pathways organise the journey from browsing creative capabilities to discussing a project.

title: n’Olive — Hand Wash Advertising Campaign
desc: A coordinated four-variant advertising series for n’Olive hand wash. Lavender, Ocean Blue, Apple Green and Gold Fresh each receive a distinct colour atmosphere within a shared product-led composition.

caseStudy.title: Creative direction
caseStudy.text: Marble pedestals, translucent glass, water droplets and softly filtered light create a polished studio setting. Large serif typography balances the product image, while generous spacing keeps the composition readable.

caseStudy.title: A connected campaign
caseStudy.text: A consistent bottle placement, headline hierarchy and three-icon row tie the four creatives together. Floral, aquatic, apple and citrus cues give each variant its own visual character.

gallery.caption: Lavender — Violet typography, lavender sprigs and soft floral light frame the purple pump bottle on a marble pedestal.
Ocean Blue — Cool blue typography, translucent glass and suspended water droplets create an airy setting around the blue bottle.
Apple Green — Fresh green apples, foliage and dappled light extend the bottle’s green palette into the surrounding scene.
Gold Fresh — Warm golden light, lemon slices and reflective glass echo the yellow bottle and citrus-inspired label.
